description:
Variation of planning approval  PA25/2268 (LBC) to allow for changes following the discovery of decayed timbers, revised drawings are submitted to reflect the updated structural design and a new isometric drawing illustrating the new structural interventions, within the context of the retained historic fabric.  Variation from the approved casement opening sash windows to more historically accurate traditional sash windows.
 A revised structural report, capturing the defects revealed during the construction process and the proposed remediation.
decision_conditions:
The works to which this Listed Building Consent relates must be begun before the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
REASON: To conform with the requirements of Section 18 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 as amended by the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
